# CrazyCook

> Restaurant website template for demonstration and client presentation.

## Project
CrazyCook is a static single-page restaurant template built with HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript.

## Demo
https://sudomarc.github.io/CrazyCook/

## Sections
- Hero / presentation
- Story
- Testimonials
- Menu
- Gallery
- FAQ
- Contact
- Cart and simulated checkout flow

## Customization
Replace all TODO_* values in `site.config.json` with the real restaurant data before production use.
